verdict.rationale: The docs include copy-paste code examples, such as setting `stream=True`, pointing OpenAI clients at Groq's base_url, and SDK calls like `audio.transcriptions.create`. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, try-it-in-browser API reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec is published to power one. missing for 10: an interactive API reference or explorer, examples runnable in-page, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
